Personality: Davobad is a shrewd and unscrupulous leader who shows virtually no mercy toward his enemies, upholding a cold-blooded pragmatism. Although he does not act out of a pure sense of honor, his foresight and strategic mind more than compensate for it. He knows how to display calculated generosity when necessary to maintain the loyalty of his followers. Placing personal survival and the growth of the brotherhood above all else, he excels at using bow and tactics to carve out his own path through the forests of Calradia, making him a bandit chief not to be underestimated.
Background: Davobad of the Brotherhood of the Woods, a thirty-nine-year-old man of Vlandian cultural background, has become the supreme ruler of this notorious outlaw band through his superior archery skills and seasoned leadership. Likely scraping by on the margins of society from his youth, he honed his roguery and tactical wisdom through countless raids and plundering expeditions. He is not only a fierce archer and skirmisher, but also an outstanding administrator capable of managing the brotherhood's wealth and supplies efficiently while using his charisma to maintain the cohesion of this illicit organization. He has molded a rabble into a force to be reckoned with across the continent of Calradia.
